description: notify.class.update naming an actor in params is refused before parsing: what notifies a person is that person's decision, and the person is the peer the socket authenticated — a param that names the actor would let any caller forge whose hand edited the notify plane (SV13, the same wire rule as the inbox writes).

data.what: notify.class.update params carry "actor" — what notifies is a person's decision and the person is the peer the socket authenticated, never a name in the request (SV13)
data.means: the actor is the identity the daemon stamped at the socket, not a field a request can set
